statement.text:
Does there exist a profinite group G that is not free but can be represented
as a projective limit G = lim(G/Nα ), where all the G/Nα are free profinite groups of
                           ←−
finite ranks?
    The finiteness condition on the ranks of the G/Nα is essential. Such a group G
cannot satisfy the first axiom of countability (O. V. Mel’nikov, Dokl. AN BSSR, 24,
no. 11 (1980), 968–970 (Russian)).                                     O. V. Mel’nikov
